CHECK ((((estado = 'PREPARADO'::text) AND (operacion = 'REGISTRAR_PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text) AND (subcampania_preparacion_id IS NOT NULL) AND (huella IS NULL) AND (registro_plantacion_id IS NULL) AND (resultado IS NULL) AND (error IS NULL) AND (http_terminal IS NULL) AND (finalizado_en IS NULL)) OR ((estado = 'CONFIRMADO'::text) AND (huella IS NOT NULL) AND (resultado IS NOT NULL) AND (error IS NULL) AND (http_terminal IS NOT NULL) AND (http_terminal = 200) AND (finalizado_en IS NOT NULL)) OR ((estado = 'RECHAZADO'::text) AND (resultado IS NULL) AND (error IS NOT NULL) AND (registro_plantacion_id IS NULL) AND (http_terminal IS NOT NULL) AND (http_terminal = ANY (ARRAY[403, 404, 409, 422, 503])) AND (finalizado_en IS NOT NULL) AND ((huella IS NOT NULL) OR COALESCE(((operacion = 'REGISTRAR_PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text) AND (subcampania_preparacion_id IS NOT NULL) AND (http_terminal = 409) AND ((error ->> 'codigo'::text) = 'PREPARACION_CANCELADA'::text)), false)))))

CHECK (((error IS NULL) OR COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((error -> 'codigo'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (btrim((error ->> 'codigo'::text)) <> ''::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((error -> 'mensaje'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (btrim((error ->> 'mensaje'::text)) <> ''::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((error -> 'campos'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((error -> 'ambitos'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND ((error ->> 'reintento'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['MISMA_CLAVE'::text, 'NUEVA_CONFIRMACION'::text, 'RECUPERAR_SESION'::text, 'NO_APLICA'::text]))), false)))

CASE
    WHEN ((estado = 'CONFIRMADO'::text) AND (operacion = 'REGISTRAR_PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text)) THEN ((registro_plantacion_id IS NOT NULL) AND (subcampania_preparacion_id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((resultado -> 'registro_plantacion_id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((resultado ->> 'registro_plantacion_id'::text) = (registro_plantacion_id)::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((resultado -> 'subcampania_id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((resultado ->> 'subcampania_id'::text) = (subcampania_preparacion_id)::text) AND ((resultado ->> 'tipo'::text) = 'PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text)), false))
    ELSE (registro_plantacion_id IS NULL)
END)

CHECK (((estado <> 'CONFIRMADO'::text) OR COALESCE(((resultado ->> 'tipo'::text) =
CASE
    WHEN (operacion = 'REGISTRAR_PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text) THEN 'PLANTACION_INICIAL'::text
    WHEN (operacion = 'CAMBIAR_ROL_GLOBAL'::text) THEN 'ROL_GLOBAL'::text

    WHEN (operacion = 'INICIALIZAR_PARTICIPACION_LEGADA'::text) THEN 'INICIALIZACION_PARTICIPACION_LEGADA'::text
    ELSE 'ACCESO'::text
END), false)))
